summary: Tested Excel export (monthly/annual/range) and Upload Nota (backend + frontend) per review. Backend pytest 9/10 passed. UI: all three download buttons in /anggaran trigger valid .xlsx downloads (monthly 136KB, range 528KB w/ 3 monthly sheets + Ringkasan, annual 136KB w/ 'Tahunan 2026' sheet). Upload flow in PPBJ DocumentForm works end-to-end: file input accepts PNG, attachment-row-0 renders with image preview + 'Terunggah' badge, del-attachment-0 removes it, document saved with attachments array containing storage_path prefixed 'sbb-keuangan/uploads/{user_id}/'. One backend spec violation found: GET /api/budgets/export-range with start>end returns 200 (should return 400 per spec) because backend/budget_excel.py::month_range silently swaps start/end.

minor.issue: start > end returns HTTP 200 (silently swaps). Spec requires HTTP 400 for invalid range. Fix in /app/backend/budget_excel.py::month_range: return [] (or raise) when (ys,ms)>(ye,me) instead of swapping. Alternatively validate in server.py before calling month_range.
Invalid period like 'bad' returns HTTP 200 with empty sheet (no format validation). Not required by spec but recommended to reject with 400.

action_items: Fix month_range() in /app/backend/budget_excel.py to NOT swap start/end; return [] so /api/budgets/export-range returns 400 when start>end (matches review-spec).
critical_code_review_comments: month_range silently swapping start/end masks user error and violates the documented 400 behaviour.
Neither /budgets/export nor /budgets/export-annual validate period/year format (both accept garbage and return an empty workbook / 500-risk). Cheap Pydantic-regex validation would be nice.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_KEGIATAN_UI PPBJ doc with a PNG attachment (uploaded to object storage sbb-keuangan/uploads/{user_id}/) - verified persistence and deleted after check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Only remaining item: main agent should update month_range() (budget_excel.py line 372-373) to return [] on inverted range instead of swapping, so export-range endpoint returns HTTP 400 as specified. Re-run test_export_and_upload.py::test_export_range_start_after_end_400 to confirm. Verified attachments successfully saved to object storage with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY-backed backend and content-type properly set on GET /api/files/{path}.
rca of the issue: backend/budget_excel.py::month_range (line 372-373) contains `if (ys,ms) > (ye,me): ys,ms,ye,me = ye,me,ys,ms` which silently normalises reversed ranges. As a result, /api/budgets/export-range still returns a valid workbook when caller passes start>end, contradicting the 400 requirement in review. Fix: remove the swap and instead `return []` so the endpoint raises HTTPException(400).
